title: Khloe Kardashian fires back at critics who slammed their use of AI in bizarre clip from show
source_used: UNILAD (pre-fetched full text); earlier story from our 9 Oct 2026 edition (item 105, Vulture)
key_facts: Khloe Kardashian posted a clip of a scene from season eight of The Kardashians (Hulu) on Instagram in answer to critics of its use of AI.
She wrote 'WATCH UNTIL THE END' and said it is frustrating, but typical these days, to see people comment after watching only the first few seconds.
Critics quoted include one social-media user asking how many gallons of freshwater were wasted for the AI video and another saying the show 'still used AI'.

The scene shows the family introduced in far-off places (Kris on a yacht in St. Tropez, Kourtney in Japan, Khloe on a Kenyan safari, Kendall and Kylie at a party in Versailles, Kim in a Swiss ski chalet), then noticing odd changes: Kylie grows a tail, Khloe gets an oversized eye, Kim a swollen ear.
The real family then enters and, after a debate on whether AI has a place in society, the real Khloe presses a 'kill switch' on the AI versions; UNILAD says the show made a stance against AI.
Season eight dropped on Hulu this week, according to UNILAD.

Earlier story: our 9 Oct 2026 edition (item 105) carried Vulture's report that the season eight premiere opens with an AI-made sketch in which fake versions of the family glitch until the real family steps in.
quote_evidence: "WATCH UNTIL THE END," she wrote alongside the video.
Ultimately, the real Khloe pressed the 'kill switch' on their AI counterparts.
Khloe Kardashian has taken to Instagram to hit back at critics who slammed the use of artificial intelligence in the latest season of The Kardashians.
why_it_matters_hint: A sketch meant as a stand against AI still drew anger because it used AI, which the star answered by telling critics to watch to the end.
event_date: Khloe Kardashian's Instagram post reported 10 Oct 2026; the sketch itself aired earlier this week with the season eight premiere.
